summary: US stocks had a rough week: the Nasdaq fell 4.5% and the S&P 500 1.9%, with the VIX up to 20 as AI-spending doubts, hot inflation data and a 10-year yield near 5.1% weighed. A global chip rout hit Korea (SK Hynix -24%, Samsung -18%; the Korea ETF EWY -15%), Taiwan, Japan and Europe's ASM International, and US equipment makers such as KLA, Lam and Onto. Oil rose on Middle East supply risk (Brent 109.86, WTI +10%) and Asian LNG jumped, while silver and lithium carbonate fell sharply and dry bulk freight kept sliding. A strengthening El Nino and EU gas storage at its lowest for the date since 2011 are the main weather and energy backdrops; clean-energy funds fell while water funds held up.

climate.headline: Brazil record September rain eases hydro worries, power forwards fall
climate.detail: Sao Paulo had its wettest September on record; ONS saw central-south reservoirs at about 55.8% at end-September. Southeast-central October power forwards fell to 146 reais/MWh on Sep 15 from 217 on Sep 1.

climate.headline: JMA: El Nino at record strength; Typhoon Champi forming
climate.detail: JMA says Nino-3 anomaly hit +4.0C in September, above the +3.6C 1997 record, and is virtually certain to last into winter. Taiwan CWA: Champi, 72 km/h on Oct 15, may become a typhoon by Oct 17.
climate.source: JMA El Nino Outlook 2026-10-09; Taiwan CWA via Taipei Times 2026-10-16

climate.headline: Rhine at Kaub hits record low; ETS review debated
climate.detail: Kaub gauge read 2 cm on Sep 25, 5 cm under the Aug 17 record. Separately, EU environment ministers debated the ETS review Oct 12 (CBAM phase-in to 2038 proposed); auction cleared EUR 86.28.
climate.source: WSA Rhein via Brussels Times 2026-09-25; EU Environment Council / EEX, 2026-10-12

climate.headline: ICPAC sees wetter Oct-Dec in Horn of Africa
climate.detail: GHACOF74 forecasts above-normal Oct-Dec rain for most of eastern Africa, over 90% likelihood in southern Ethiopia, southern Somalia and northeast Kenya. Niño-3.4 at +1.8C; 81% chance of very strong El Nino. IOD neutral, likely turning positive.

climate.headline: NOAA: strong El Nino; ABARES sees Australian wheat crop down 17%
climate.detail: NOAA CPC (8 Oct 2026) has an El Nino Advisory with Nino-3.4 at +2.1C and 54% odds of a historic event in Sep-Nov. ABARES forecasts Australia's 2026-27 wheat crop at 29.9 Mt, down 17%.
climate.source: NOAA CPC (8 Oct 2026); ABARES via S&P Global Platts (8-9 Oct 2026)

climate.headline: IMD: northeast monsoon set to start over south India
climate.detail: IMD said conditions favour onset of the northeast monsoon over the south peninsula on Oct 15, with a wet spell Oct 14-19. Very heavy rain (115.6-204.4 mm) possible in Kerala and Tamil Nadu on Oct 15.

climate.headline: Vietnam: Mekong inflow seen below average into 2027
climate.detail: Vietnam's forecast centre expects rainfall 20-40% below normal in the south, Mekong inflow below average through 2026 and about 30% short in Jan-May 2027. Flows were 10-75% below average Jun-Aug. Nino-3.4 was +1.8C.
climate.source: Vietnam National Centre for Hydro-Meteorological Forecasting via Viet Nam News, 2026-09-26
